name: Mondelez Houston Distribution Center - Houston TX

fieldNotes.locate: Resolved to 6903 W Sam Houston Pkwy N, Houston TX 77041 — a ~105,594 SF industrial distribution building in a corporate park off Beltway 8 (W Sam Houston Pkwy N) in NW Houston. Google geocode returned a ROOFTOP hit at 29.870738,-95.565030. This is a multi-tenant warehouse; Mondelez is one tenant of the building (the building also shows other industrial tenants / FMCSA-registered carriers).
fieldNotes.facilityNature: Multi-tenant warehouse. The audit covers the geocoded building and its shared truck yard. Dock doors run along the building's NORTH face under a dock canopy; the south face is a two-story office with landscaped employee/visitor parking and an open (uncontrolled) car entrance.
fieldNotes.truckGate: The truck yard on the north side is fully enclosed by chain-link fence with privacy slats. Street View (Oct 2025) shows the truck-yard entrance on the NE side as a sliding chain-link gate across the truck driveway off the side street. truckGate = true.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed guard booth observed at the truck-yard gate — sliding chain-link gate only; remote/kiosk check-in inferred. Flagged uncertain (multi-tenant yard; a small booth could be present but not clearly visible).
fieldNotes.drop: The shared truck yard is busy and packed — trailers, tractors, equipment, lumber and materials. A band of parked trailers without tractors gives a drop area in the 25-50 band; classed dropYard true.
fieldNotes.dockDoorCount: Estimated ~22 doors along the geocoded building's north dock canopy for a ~105k SF warehouse. Overhead estimate — flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Deep inside NW Houston's dense industrial fabric beside Beltway 8 / US-290 interchange — Urban.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Single dock cluster on the north face — ship/receive not physically separate.
fieldNotes.geofences: Perimeter captures the geocoded building and its north truck-yard share: ~200 m N-S x ~160 m E-W ≈ 7.9 acres. The truck yard is shared with the neighboring building's tenants.
